source.coverage_note: logged requests only; missing days are not zero; September 28 is partial and excluded

method.request_normalized_cycle_proxy: Sum each of six camera-stage total_tokens/completed_requests, plus cross_camera total_tokens/completed_requests multiplied by cross_camera completed requests / montrose_shoreline completed requests.
caveats: Request counts are not deduplicated retries and do not prove valid complete cycles.
Cached input is a subset of input and reasoning output is a subset of output; neither is added to total tokens.
Dollar cost is not estimated because applicable billing/tier reconciliation is absent.
Effectiveness equivalence is not established because no held-out Jubilee event/control set exists.
The September 28 cadence merge is outside this complete-day window; future comparisons must normalize for intended schedule changes.

comparison_to_2026_09_26_audit.interpretation: The measured reduction is effectively unchanged after adding September 26-27; no additional efficiency gain is demonstrated.

decision: Retain the compact/cache behavior. Nine complete days support a stable approximately 7.9% request-normalized token reduction, but not the 50% directional target and not equivalent Jubilee-event detection. Do not count future lower request volume caused by cadence changes as model-call efficiency without normalizing coverage and intended schedule.
